not_admitted.reason: No frozen segmentation, correspondence, or validation implementation exists; naming an unvalidated diagnostic would not create credible evidence.
The released interface expects normalized seven-dimensional Cartesian EEF input and the exact RoboArena action/state adapter has not passed fail-closed validation.
The registered first/last-frame arm already captures the endpoint hypothesis; another weighting after pilot outcomes would add researcher degrees of freedom without a disjoint holdout.

freeze_rule: No additional evaluator arm may be scored on these heldout sessions after their labels are opened. A future arm requires a new frozen disjoint benchmark split or new benchmark snapshot.
